Aston Villa Signs Ibrahim Mbaye from PSG for €55 Million

Aston Villa has completed the signing of Ibrahim Mbaye from Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) for a fee of €55 million. This transfer is part of a larger summer sell-off by PSG, which has reportedly generated $460 million. The New York Times also reported that Aston Villa is in talks regarding a contract extension for Ian Maatsen.
